meta.name: find-skills
meta.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现并安装可扩展功能的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果用户常问如何实现某个功能，需要推荐安装技能。
copy.tagline_en: Discover and install skills to extend capabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if users often ask how to do something and need skill recommendations.

howto.what: 当你需要某个功能时，Claude 会先查 skills.sh 榜单、再用 npx skills find 搜索已有技能，核对安装量、来源和 GitHub 星数，给你安装命令，也可以直接帮你装上。
howto.when: 当你说「怎么做 X」「有没有做 X 的技能」等提问，或提到想扩展能力、寻找工具、模板、工作流时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一个做 React 性能优化的技能
say.note: 先查榜单再搜索，给出安装命令

say.text: 有哪些和 PR review 相关的技能？
say.note: 会附上安装量和来源供你判断
运行 npx skills add 帮你安装

howto.what_en: When you need a capability, Claude checks the skills.sh leaderboard and `npx skills find`, verifies install counts, source and GitHub stars, then gives you the install command or installs the skill for you.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask "how do I do X" or "find a skill for X", or say you want to extend capabilities or search tools, templates and workflows.

say_en.text: Find me a skill for React performance optimization
say_en.note: Checks leaderboard, searches, gives install command

say_en.text: What skills exist for PR reviews?
say_en.note: Shows install count and source so you can judge
